about_short_description.short_description: Templarbit protects applications from malicious activity.

product.name: Next-Gen Third-Party Risk Assessments
product.description: A service that monitors the security posture of any vendor in real time to support third-party risk assessments.

product.name: Comprehensive Monitoring
product.description: A monitoring service that tracks uptime, security configurations, subdomain discovery, certificate transparency, response times, SSL, DNS, and email settings for web applications.

product.name: Domain Impersonation Detection
product.description: A service that identifies look-alike and name-blending domains used to impersonate a company’s website or app and alerts users when new such domains appear.

product.name: Security Configuration Checks
product.description: A tool that assesses the security posture of web applications and websites by evaluating key security headers and settings, providing grades and recommendations.

product.name: API Access
product.description: APIs that provide access to Templarbit’s collected security data, enabling custom workflows, integrations, and product extensions.

product.name: Vendor Monitoring
product.description: A service that provides insights into the security posture and performance metrics of vendors critical to a business.
